$ rnpath --help
exit: Some(0)
--- stdout
usage: rnpath [-h] [--config CONFIG] [--version] [-t] [-a] [-u] [-V] [-E]
              [-m hops] [-M hops] [-r] [-d] [-D] [-x] [-w seconds] [-R hash]
              [-i path] [-W seconds] [-b] [-B] [-U] [--duration DURATION]
              [--reason REASON] [-p] [-j] [-A] [--capture hops] [-v]
              [destination] [list_filter]

Reticulum Path Management Utility

positional arguments:
  destination           hexadecimal hash of the destination
  list_filter           filter for remote blackhole list view

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG       path to alternative Reticulum config directory
  --version             show program's version number and exit
  -t, --table           show all known paths
  -a, --active          show in-use paths only
  -u, --usage           show path usage time
  -V, --vias            show via transport IDs
  -E, --expiry          show path expiry times
  -m hops, --max hops   maximum hops to filter path table by
  -M hops, --min-value hops
                        minimum value to filter path table by
  -r, --rates           show announce rate info
  -d, --drop            remove the path to a destination
  -D, --drop-announces  drop all queued announces
  -x, --drop-via        drop all paths via specified transport instance
  -w seconds            timeout before giving up
  -R hash               transport identity hash of remote instance to manage
  -i path               path to identity used for remote management
  -W seconds            timeout before giving up on remote queries
  -b, --blackholed      list blackholed identities
  -B, --blackhole       blackhole identity
  -U, --unblackhole     unblackhole identity
  --duration DURATION   duration of blackhole enforcement in hours
  --reason REASON       reason for blackholing identity
  -p, --blackholed-list
                        view published blackhole list for remote transport
                        instance
  -j, --json            output in JSON format
  -A, --analyze         Analyze tables
  --capture hops        path to capture file for analyze mode
  -v, --verbose
--- stderr
--- end

$ rnpath --version
exit: Some(0)
--- stdout
rnpath <VERSION>
--- stderr
--- end

$ rnpath --no-such-option
exit: Some(2)
--- stdout
--- stderr
usage: rnpath [-h] [--config CONFIG] [--version] [-t] [-a] [-u] [-V] [-E]
              [-m hops] [-M hops] [-r] [-d] [-D] [-x] [-w seconds] [-R hash]
              [-i path] [-W seconds] [-b] [-B] [-U] [--duration DURATION]
              [--reason REASON] [-p] [-j] [-A] [--capture hops] [-v]
              [destination] [list_filter]
rnpath: error: unrecognized arguments: --no-such-option
--- end
